POLICY.DESCRIPTION: To enhance your experience and ensure the great functioning of our app, we use cookies and similar technologies. These tools are essential for providing you with a seamless and personalized journey, from remembering your settings to keeping your session secure. The personal information gathered helps us understand how you use the app, allowing us to continuously improve its performance and enhance the features you love most. Your trust is important, and we are committed to being transparent. Our practices are in full compliance with European law, specifically Article 7 of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) — "Conditions applicable to consent". By continuing to use our app, you consent to our use of these cookies.
